description: The College of Eloquence is the home of bards whose magic enhances their persuasion and oratory. These bards are masters of persuasion and rhetoric.

features.name: Silver Tongue
features.description: When you make a Persuasion check, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

features.name: Unsettling Words
features.description: When you use Bardic Inspiration, you can choose to use Unsettling Words instead. The creature has disadvantage on the next saving throw within 1 minute.

features.name: Unfailing Inspiration
features.description: When a creature uses one of your Bardic Inspiration dice and fails the ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, it doesn't expend the die.

features.name: Undeniable Words
features.description: When you use Unsettling Words, you can cause the target to have disadvantage on saving throws against Enchantment spells you cast within 1 minute.
